assumptions.geometry: Only Fremont canopy length 419.1 m is source-derived. Width 20 m, three conceptual zones, and Honolulu customer queue 10 m by 6 m are assumptions.
assumptions.weather: Ta, RH, MRT and background speeds are representative test conditions, not weather observations.
assumptions.occupancy: Four prescribed hourly populations, uniform within each zone; integration over 4 h.
assumptions.velocity: v = v0 + (reference strip speed - 0.2 m/s). Scalar mixing and speed increments are independent reduced inputs.
assumptions.strips: Three equal-area delivery strips per device, distinct from demand zones. Nominal allocations prohibit overlap and boundary clipping.
assumptions.background: Outdoor scalar background externally maintained; no calibrated humidity-storage ODE.
assumptions.heat: chi=0 neglects local electrical heating; full electrical power enters energy and cost.
assumptions.annual: 600 representative operating hours per year; the four-hour profile is a service test.
assumptions.clipping: Separate stress test retains near then middle then far strip; lost area has no service credit; full power/water retained.
assumptions.policy: Task 4 only: q>=0.8, mean SET-excess relief>=1.5 C, floor clearance<=3.5%, annual energy<=30 kWh/m2.
